core.description: Core — a GestureProvider follows every finger of each Gesture, with motion values, and hands it to every enabled useGesture in the nested GestureZones that hear it. It never says what a Gesture means.

touch-input listens to the page and holds the browser back on each zone, leaving Native Scrolls their touches; zone follows the fingers, walks up the zones to find who hears each Gesture, and puts it together for React. Whether a release clicks is the browser's call unless a listener prevents it

facade.description: Facade — the package's one entry point.

use-gesture.description: The facade re-exports each layer; lower layers never import higher ones.
